question: Which among the following is a folk dance of Jammu and Kashmir, India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rouf.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rouf:-**

 
 
• It​ is a **folk dance** of **Jammu and Kashmir, **India.
 
• It is performed by **women **on special occasions like festivals and weddings.
 
• The dance is characterized by a** circular formation and rhythmic movements **of the feet and hands.
 
• The dancers wear **colorful traditional attire **and adorn themselves with jewelry and accessories.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kathak:-**

 
 
• It​ is a **classical dance form **of North India that originated in the **Mughal era.**
 
 
 
• **Bihu:-**
 
 
• It​** **is a folk dance of** Assam, India**, performed during the Bihu festival.
 
 
 
• **Bhangra:-**
 
 
• It​** **is a folk dance of **Punjab, **India, performed by men on the beats of dhol and bhangra music.
